[ This is a sealed-bid second-price auction with 3 bidders and i.i.d. uniform values. For risk-neutral bidders, the weakly dominant strategy is to bid your true value: it wins exactly when your value exceeds rivals’ maximum and you pay the second-highest bid, maximizing expected profit over time. There is no prior history to adjust for, and discretization (0.1) doesn’t change the truth-telling result.
